exact_source_text:
Yoga followed by EMDR; 10 weekly 75-minute trauma-sensitive group yoga sessions emphasizing body awareness, breathing, grounding, and non-judgmental acceptance, followed by 10 weekly individual EMDR therapy sessions.
Yoga: sessions were facilitated by a certified trauma sensitive yoga instructor and psychologist co-therapist. Each session consisted of the same sequence: first gentle movements while seated on a chair, then progressively more demanding movements while standing and then on a yoga mat on the floor (about 50 minutes for sequence). Sessions concluded with relaxation (7 min), brief mindfulness meditation (3 min), and a post-session discussion (10–15 min). Sessions were conducted without hands-on adjustments and with the emphasis on the choice of whether or not to do the suggested postures or their adaptations.

exact_source_text: DBT for PTSD based on standard DBT with additional trauma-focused cognitive-behavioral interventions, and techniques drawn from compassion-focused therapy and acceptance and commitment therapy.
